lede: The biggest item this week is San Miguel County's special BOCC meeting Wednesday, where commissioners will consider changing the AMI limits on deed-restricted properties at Pinion Park — a technical tweak that directly shapes who qualifies for affordable housing in the county. Also worth your attention: Ridgway's council ratifies letters supporting a federal disaster declaration for the Gold Mountain Fire, the county Planning Commission weighs in on Land Use Code amendments covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal, and the Housing Code SSR working group hits its eighth session on stripping barriers to workforce housing production.

notable.stake: Council ratifies support for federal disaster declaration after Gold Mountain Fire devastation.
